jobs.title: First flour order
jobs.text: Haul this flour to {dropoff} for my new shop.
jobs.thanks: The first sack is in; only the oven to go!

jobs.title: First helper ride
jobs.text: Please take my helper to {dropoff} and cheer her.
jobs.thanks: She loves the smell of early bread.

jobs.title: Sign test run
jobs.text: Race my new sign to {dropoff} before the sun sets.
jobs.thanks: The sign glows sweetly over the street.

jobs.title: Opening day ride
jobs.text: Take my ribbon guests to {dropoff} for the shop.
jobs.thanks: The bakery opens its doors with a happy bell!

jobs.title: Quiet route ride
jobs.text: Take my grandchild to {dropoff} to learn mirrors.
jobs.thanks: My grandchild notices every quiet corner.

jobs.title: Practice parcel
jobs.text: Deliver this parcel to {dropoff} with steady care.
jobs.thanks: They nod like a seasoned bus driver.

jobs.title: Timed route run
jobs.text: Guide the timed route to {dropoff} with care.
jobs.thanks: They smile when the last stop comes near.

jobs.title: Driving test ride
jobs.text: Drive my grandchild to {dropoff} for their test.
jobs.thanks: They wave from the driver seat with pride!

jobs.title: Guitar case run
jobs.text: Carry my shy guitar to {dropoff} with care.
jobs.thanks: The guitar hums a brave little note.

jobs.title: Bandmate ride
jobs.text: Bring my drummer to {dropoff} and encourage her.
jobs.thanks: She taps a gentle rhythm on the seat.

jobs.title: Poster test run
jobs.text: Hustle our posters to {dropoff} before dark.
jobs.thanks: The little hall has room for a shy band.

jobs.title: First gig ride
jobs.text: Drive our band to {dropoff} and keep us calm.
jobs.thanks: They strum their first song under warm lights!

jobs.title: Pond stop for vet
jobs.text: Please take me to {dropoff} to check the pond.
jobs.thanks: She nibbled clover there, then wandered off again.

jobs.title: Lure for the tortoise
jobs.text: Haul this cozy hideaway to {dropoff} for a lure.
jobs.thanks: The hideaway drew her scent, but not her slow legs.

jobs.title: Dusk dash
jobs.text: Race the cart to {dropoff} before dusk settles.
jobs.thanks: We spotted shell dust near the old mill gate.

jobs.title: Scanning the lanes
jobs.text: Drive me to {dropoff} and keep an eye out.
jobs.thanks: She is home at last, slow, stubborn, and loved.

jobs.title: Trees for the set
jobs.text: Carry the painted trees to {dropoff} for the set.
jobs.thanks: The forest looked lovely, though the bear was shy.

jobs.title: Line practice ride
jobs.text: Take young Bram to {dropoff} for line practice.
jobs.thanks: He knows every word, but still hides behind trees.

jobs.title: Costume curtain dash
jobs.text: Rush the costumes to {dropoff} before curtain.
jobs.thanks: The crowns fit, and the bear finally bowed.

jobs.title: Bram to the finale
jobs.text: Drive young Bram to {dropoff} for the finale.
jobs.thanks: The play opened, and shy Bram took a standing bow.

jobs.title: Compost for the vine
jobs.text: Haul this rich compost to {dropoff} for the vine.
jobs.thanks: The leaves grew huge, and so did my hopes.

jobs.title: Field check ride
jobs.text: Drive me to {dropoff} and watch the marrow.
jobs.thanks: It stretched like a cloud and glowed green.

jobs.title: Fair cart dash
jobs.text: Guide the cart to {dropoff} before the fair.
jobs.thanks: The judges leaned close and smiled at such a giant.

jobs.title: Ribbon home delivery
jobs.text: Carry the blue ribbon to {dropoff} for my shelf.
jobs.thanks: The marrow fed the whole town, ribbon and all.
